parameter_note: margin, tail threshold, primary budget, and latency/trial counts were chosen on 2026-10-18 from the proposal's examples, before any held-out data existed

development.role: variance pilot and regression diagnostics; already used for tuning, so it cannot pass the decision rule

held_out.requirements: authored and judged independently of graf tuning; pooled top-10 files of every arm and Graphify judged blind; freeze sha256 here before any arm runs
held_out.authoring: 123 queries (111 with code evidence) drafted by three Claude subagents, one per repository, that read only the pinned snapshots and had no access to graf, Graphify, or any retrieval output; the operator chose this over independent human authoring. A random sample of 9 was spot-checked, 4 line by line. Weaker independence than human authoring; report it with every result
held_out.judging: after the run, pool the top-10 cited files of every arm and Graphify per query; a fresh agent that is not told which system cited a file judges each pooled file; recall uses author labels plus judged-relevant files

comparators: last accepted graf version, once one exists

primary.hypothesis: candidate delivers fewer tokens than the comparator
primary.test: one-sided paired sign-flip permutation on comparator minus candidate

guardrails.test: one-sided paired sign-flip non-inferiority on candidate minus comparator
guardrails.scope: queries whose annotations contain code evidence

tail.severe_loss: candidate code_file_hint_recall is 0 at any budget where the comparator's is above 0

latency.report: median and bootstrap interval; cold and warm cache separately
latency.held_out_quality_run: 1 invocation per tool and case (outputs are deterministic and checked); timings from this run are not used for inference
latency.latency_run: 15 alternating invocations per case on a quiet machine, only for arms that pass the decision rule, against Graphify

agent_trials.success: non-inferiority, Wilson intervals, pass^k for k = 1..5
agent_trials.efficiency: superiority on total cost across all attempts
agent_trials.solver: Claude Code 2.1.302 headless: claude -p --model claude-haiku-5-5 --tools "" --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config <broker server for the arm> --setting-sources "" --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --output-format stream-json --max-budget-usd 0.50; the broker (benchmark/task_session.py) is the only tool surface
agent_trials.billing: the operator's Claude Code Max 5x subscription; caps are usage-equivalent, not charges
agent_trials.per_run_cap: --max-budget-usd 0.50 estimated; a run that hits the cap counts as a failure with its full usage
agent_trials.pacing: batches sized to the subscription's usage windows; every attempt, including capped and errored runs, is recorded
agent_trials.usage_source: stream-json usage per model call; estimated cost reported separately from tokens
agent_trials.isolation_check: 2026-10-18 smoke call: empty cwd, no tools or MCP servers, ~730 input tokens total, model reported no personal instructions or recalled context

rule.unit: task; each task's 5 attempts per arm are averaged, and the 20 task means are paired across arms

primary.aggregation: mean list-price estimate over every attempt, including failed and capped ones
primary.hypothesis: candidate costs less than the comparator
primary.test: one-sided paired sign-flip permutation on comparator minus candidate

success.test: one-sided paired sign-flip non-inferiority on candidate minus comparator

secondary: pass^k for k = 1..5 (unbiased per-task estimator, averaged over tasks)
rule.completeness: every planned task x trial x arm must have a summary with complete usage; infrastructure aborts are rerun from scratch and their partial runs are kept outside the plan
rule.scope: synthetic fault-repair tasks are harness evidence, not natural held-out issues; a pass cannot authorize product promotion by itself
rule.multiplicity: both alphas are divided by the number of tested arms (candidates plus controls) in a batch
rule.comparators: a batch may list several comparators; a candidate passes only if it passes against every one (intersection-union, no alpha split across comparators)

t.outcome: decided 2026-10-20 under v10: fail (graf cost more; results/agent-decision-t.json)

arm_definitions.graf_floor: retrieve runs graf locate --file-score damped --stop floor (the preregistered held-out arm graf_locate_damped_floor; constants unchanged); same system prompt as batch t
arm_definitions.search_only: no retrieve tool; read, search, edit, test, finish only; the system prompt omits the retrieve clause. A control: it can never pass the batch or be promoted
arm_definitions.graphify: as in batch t, rerun in this batch's interleaved order

t2.rationale: batch t: both arms solved 100/100, graf cost more because its retrieve payload fills the budget and stays in context; the closest held-out arm returns fewer tokens. The control asks whether any retrieve tool pays for itself on these tasks

t3.arm_definitions: as in batch t2; search_only is now a comparator, not a control
t3.rationale: batch t2 left graf_floor against search-only unresolved on ceiling-level synthetic tasks; natural held-out tasks test whether graf's retrieval pays for itself

natural_tasks.purpose: held-out natural repair tasks hard enough to separate arms; frozen before any solver sees them
natural_tasks.source: merged upstream pull requests of the pinned Cobra, Flask, and Fastify repositories whose merge commit is an ancestor of the pinned commit and which close a GitHub issue
natural_tasks.enumeration: per repository, newest merge first, walking back from the pin; accept the first 10 candidates that meet every criterion; record every rejected candidate with its reason
criteria: the closed issue reports incorrect existing behavior (a bug), judged from the issue title and body alone; feature requests, docs, typing-only, dependency, and CI changes are excluded
the pull request changes at least one non-test source file (.go, .py, .js) and at least one test file
non-test changes span at most 10 files and 400 changed lines (v13; was 5 and 150)
every non-test hunk reverts uniquely on the pinned snapshot (code, docs, and changelog are all reverted); a hunk whose context drifted reverts by removing its added block when that block is unique
fail-to-pass: with the fix's tests installed, the reverted snapshot fails and the pinned snapshot passes, within 180 s; a timeout is a rejection
natural_tasks.issue_text: issue title, a blank line, then the issue body verbatim with HTML comments removed and truncated at 4,000 characters; no comments, links to the fix, or edits
natural_tasks.hidden_tests: the fix's test-file changes are reverted in the agent's copy and installed only during grading
natural_tasks.verification: Go: go test on the packages of the changed test files; Python: pytest on the changed test files; JavaScript: node --test on the changed test files
natural_tasks.contamination: fixes may be in the solver's training data; this affects every arm equally and is reported
natural_tasks.exclusions: a candidate whose closing fix does not address the behavior its issue reports is excluded, with the reason recorded
natural_tasks.runtime: Fastify tasks run against .research/task-runtime/fastify-full: the pinned package.json with devDependencies, installed with --ignore-scripts, versions in its package-lock.json

revisions.change: adopted query-level rule with non-inferiority margin 0.05
margin 0.05 -> 0.10 and held-out minimum 70 -> 110, decided after the development-set variance pilot implied ~410-430 queries at 0.05; no held-out data existed
recorded the query-time candidate arm definitions, constants, and a Bonferroni split of the primary alpha across experimental arms before any run
added index-time arms B2 (path weight 3) and C1-C3 (English stopwords, none, English plus full identifiers) for locate before any run; primary alpha now split across 9 experimental arms

added combined arms (damped file score with gap or floor stopping) and fixed the agent model to claude-haiku-5-5, before any held-out data existed. The combination was proposed after seeing development-set diagnostics, so its held-out result is the only valid evidence; primary alpha now split across 11 experimental arms

specified the agent solver (headless Claude Code with Haiku, broker-only tools) and per-run cap under the operator's subscription; decision rule unchanged; machine-readable max_budget_usd and --disable-slash-commands added the same day, before any trial
froze the held-out workload (sha256 665e1fbacccc88a0...) before any retrieval tool saw it

split the held-out run into a 1-repeat quality/token run (any load) and a separate 15-repeat latency run for passing arms; 15 repeats of 14 tools over 246 cases would take ~6 h on a quiet machine. Decided before any held-out run

made the agent-trial success margin (0.10), primary cost test, and pairing unit explicit before outcome analysis; 20 of 200 trials had run and only the runner's per-trial pass/fail lines had been seen, with no aggregation or arm comparison

added agent batch t2 (graf_floor candidate, search_only control, graphify comparator; Bonferroni over tested arms) before any t2 run; moved batch t's arms into agent_trials.batches without changing its rule
froze the natural-task selection protocol and batch t3 (graf_floor against search_only and graphify, both required) before mining any candidate

raised the fix-size bound to 10 files and 400 lines because the v12 criteria yielded 17 valid tasks (Cobra 5, Flask 2, Fastify 10), below the minimum of 20; recorded the drift fallback, timeout rejection, mismatch exclusion, and Fastify dev-dependency runtime. No solver had seen any natural task

froze benchmark/natural-tasks.json (18 tasks: Cobra 5, Flask 3, Fastify 10; sha256 e2867b679cf9d5cd...) and set the minimum to that full yield instead of loosening the criteria further, which would admit feature work. Revert regions now keep per-region context. No solver had seen any natural task

arms.constants: src/policy.rs: gap minimum 3, buffer 2, search share 0.9; floor ratio 0.5; damping 1, 0.5, 0.25. src/terms.rs: C1 is Lucene's 33-word EnglishAnalyzer stop set; C3 adds lowercased identifiers that split into two or more parts; B2 counts path terms 3 times (BM25F, integer weight, shared length normalization)
arms.deferred: index-time arms run with locate only: search fills the budget, so it cannot pass the token test whatever the analyzer
arms.multiplicity: the primary test for each experimental arm uses alpha / number of experimental arms (Bonferroni); guardrails and the tail cap apply unchanged; report every arm, including losing ones
